title: Untrapping Product Teams (David Pereira) — 'Making money by destroying value instead of creating it'
summary: Product-management thought leader David Pereira hosts Eric for a 37-minute Untrapping Product Teams conversation released Sep 3. Chapter markers span Sol Price getting fired from FedMart, Costco's governance fortress, Anthropic's mission protection, the culture bank ('every decision is a deposit or a withdrawal'), and why 'harder is easier'.
blockquote: Think about a favorite product after the company went public or got taken over by private equity. Did it get better? Of course not. Eric puts a name on what's happening: corruption. Making money by destroying value instead of creating it.
blockquote_source: David Pereira on Untrapping Product Teams
